NASB.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.2: 'Command the sons of Israel and say to them, 'You shall be careful to present My offering, My food for My offerings by fire, of a soothing aroma to Me, at their appointed time.'
NASB.3: 'You shall say to them, 'This is the offering by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs one year old without defect [as] a continual burnt offering every day.
NASB.4: 'You shall offer the one lamb in the morning and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight;
NASB.5: also a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with a fourth of a hin of beaten oil.
NASB.6: 'It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai as a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.
NASB.7: 'Then the drink offering with it [shall be] a fourth of a hin for each lamb, in the holy place you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD.
NASB.8: 'The other lamb you shall offer at twilight; as the grain offering of the morning and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering by fire, a soothing aroma to the LORD.
NASB.9: 'Then on the sabbath day two male lambs one year old without defect, and two-tenths [of an] [ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and its drink offering:
NASB.10: '[This is] the burnt offering of every sabbath in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
NASB.11: 'Then at the beginning of each of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls and one ram, seven male lambs one year old without defect;
NASB.12: and three-tenths [of an] [ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, for each bull; and two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, for the one ram;
NASB.13: and a tenth [of an] [ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering for each lamb, for a burnt offering of a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.
NASB.14: 'Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull and a third of a hin for the ram and a fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering of each month throughout the months of the year.
NASB.15: 'And one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD; it shall be offered with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.
NASB.16: 'Then on the fourteenth day of the first month shall be the LORD'S Passover.
NASB.17: 'On the fifteenth day of this month [shall be] a feast, unleavened bread [shall be] eaten for seven days.
NASB.18: 'On the first day [shall be] a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
NASB.19: 'You shall present an offering by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls and one ram and seven male lambs one year old, having them without defect.
NASB.20: 'For their grain offering, you shall offer fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths [of an] [ephah] for a bull and two-tenths for the ram.
NASB.21: 'A tenth [of an] [ephah] you shall offer for each of the seven lambs;
NASB.22: and one male goat for a sin offering to make atonement for you.
NASB.23: 'You shall present these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
NASB.24: 'After this manner you shall present daily, for seven days, the food of the offering by fire, of a soothing aroma to the LORD; it shall be presented with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.
NASB.25: 'On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
NASB.26: 'Also on the day of the first fruits, when you present a new grain offering to the LORD in your [Feast of] Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
NASB.27: 'You shall offer a burnt offering for a soothing aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs one year old;
NASB.28: and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths [of an] [ephah] for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
NASB.29: a tenth for each of the seven lambs;
NASB.30: [also] one male goat to make atonement for you.
NASB.31: 'Besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, you shall present [them] with their drink offerings. They shall be without defect.

NKJV.1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NKJV.2: “Command the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘My offering, My food for My offerings made by fire as a sweet aroma to Me, you shall be careful to offer to Me at their appointed time.’
NKJV.3: “And you shall say to them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs in their first year without blemish, day by day, as a regular burnt offering.
NKJV.4: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, the other lamb you shall offer in the evening,
NKJV.5: and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil.
NKJV.6: It is a regular burnt offering which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
NKJV.7: And its drink offering shall be one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in a holy place you shall pour out the drink to the LORD as an offering.
NKJV.8: The other lamb you shall offer in the evening; as the morning grain offering and its drink offering, you shall offer it as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.
NKJV.9: ‘And on the Sabbath day two lambs in their first year, without blemish, and two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, with its drink offering—
NKJV.10: this is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering.
NKJV.11: ‘At the beginnings of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without blemish;
NKJV.12: three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
NKJV.13: and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
NKJV.14: Their drink offering shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering for each month throughout the months of the year.
NKJV.15: Also one kid of the goats as a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
NKJV.16: ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month is the Passover of the LORD.
NKJV.17: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast; unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
NKJV.18: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.
NKJV.19: And you shall present an offering made by fire as a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.
NKJV.20: Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah you shall offer for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram;
NKJV.21: you shall offer one-tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs;
NKJV.22: also one goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
NKJV.23: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a regular burnt offering.
NKJV.24: In this manner you shall offer the food of the offering made by fire daily for seven days, as a sweet aroma to the LORD; it shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
NKJV.25: And on the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.
NKJV.26: ‘Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new grain offering to the LORD at your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.
NKJV.27: You shall present a burnt offering as a sweet aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year,
NKJV.28: with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
NKJV.29: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;
NKJV.30: also one kid of the goats, to make atonement for you.
NKJV.31: Be sure they are without blemish. You shall present them with their drink offerings, besides the regular burnt offering with its grain offering.

ESV.1: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.2: “Command the people of Israel and say to them, ‘My offering, my food for my food offerings, my pleasing aroma, you shall be careful to offer to me at its appointed time.’
ESV.3: And you shall say to them, This is the food offering that you shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs a year old without blemish, day by day, as a regular offering.
ESV.4: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight;
ESV.5: also a tenth of an ephah  of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with a quarter of a hin  of beaten oil.
ESV.6: It is a regular burnt offering, which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
ESV.7: Its drink offering shall be a quarter of a hin for each lamb. In the Holy Place you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD.
ESV.8: The other lamb you shall offer at twilight. Like the grain offering of the morning, and like its drink offering, you shall offer it as a food offering, with a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
ESV.9: “On the Sabbath day, two male lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
ESV.10: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
ESV.11: “At the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls from the herd, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;
ESV.12: also three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull, and two tenths of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
ESV.13: and a tenth of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for every lamb; for a burnt offering with a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
ESV.14: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, a third of a hin for a ram, and a quarter of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of each month throughout the months of the year.
ESV.15: Also one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD; it shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
ESV.16: “On the fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD's Passover,
ESV.17: and on the fifteenth day of this month is a feast. Seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
ESV.18: On the first day there shall be a holy convocation. You shall not do any ordinary work,
ESV.19: but offer a food offering, a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; see that they are without blemish;
ESV.20: also their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil; three tenths of an ephah shall you offer for a bull, and two tenths for a ram;
ESV.21: a tenth shall you offer for each of the seven lambs;
ESV.22: also one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
ESV.23: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a regular burnt offering.
ESV.24: In the same way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of a food offering, with a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
ESV.25: And on the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall not do any ordinary work.
ESV.26: “On the day of the firstfruits, when you offer a grain offering of new grain to the LORD at your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall not do any ordinary work,
ESV.27: but offer a burnt offering, with a pleasing aroma to the LORD: two bulls from the herd, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;
ESV.28: also their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths of an ephah for each bull, two tenths for one ram,
ESV.29: a tenth for each of the seven lambs;
ESV.30: with one male goat, to make atonement for you.
ESV.31: Besides the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, you shall offer them and their drink offering. See that they are without blemish.

NLT.2: “Give these instructions to the people of Israel: The offerings you present as special gifts are a pleasing aroma to me; they are my food. See to it that they are brought at the appointed times and offered according to my instructions.
NLT.3: “Say to the people: This is the special gift you must present to the LORD as your daily burnt offering. You must offer two one-year-old male lambs with no defects.
NLT.4: Sacrifice one lamb in the morning and the other in the evening.
NLT.5: With each lamb you must offer a grain offering of two quarts of choice flour mixed with one quart of pure oil of pressed olives.
NLT.6: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
NLT.7: Along with it you must present the proper liquid offering of one quart of alcoholic drink with each lamb, poured out in the Holy Place as an offering to the LORD.
NLT.8: Offer the second lamb in the evening with the same grain offering and liquid offering. It, too, is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
NLT.9: “On the Sabbath day, sacrifice two one-year-old male lambs with no defects. They must be accompanied by a grain offering of four quarts of choice flour moistened with olive oil, and a liquid offering.
NLT.10: This is the burnt offering to be presented each Sabbath day, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its accompanying liquid offering.
NLT.11: “On the first day of each month, present an extra burnt offering to the LORD of two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.
NLT.12: These must be accompanied by grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil — six quarts with each bull, four quarts with the ram,
NLT.13: and two quarts with each lamb. This burnt offering will be a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
NLT.14: You must also present a liquid offering with each sacrifice: two quarts of wine for each bull, a third of a gallon for the ram, and one quart for each lamb. Present this monthly burnt offering on the first day of each month throughout the year.
NLT.15: “On the first day of each month, you must also offer one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD. This is in addition to the regular burnt offering and its accompanying liquid offering.
NLT.16: “On the fourteenth day of the first month, you must celebrate the LORD’s Passover.
NLT.17: On the following day — the fifteenth day of the month — a joyous, seven-day festival will begin, but no bread made with yeast may be eaten.
NLT.18: The first day of the festival will be an official day for holy assembly, and no ordinary work may be done on that day.
NLT.19: As a special gift you must present a burnt offering to the LORD — two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.
NLT.20: These will be accompanied by grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil — six quarts with each bull, four quarts with the ram,
NLT.21: and two quarts with each of the seven lambs.
NLT.22: You must also offer a male goat as a sin offering to purify yourselves and make yourselves right with the LORD.
NLT.23: Present these offerings in addition to your regular morning burnt offering.
NLT.24: On each of the seven days of the festival, this is how you must prepare the food offering that is presented as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. These will be offered in addition to the regular burnt offerings and liquid offerings.
NLT.25: The seventh day of the festival will be another official day for holy assembly, and no ordinary work may be done on that day.
NLT.26: “At the Festival of Harvest, when you present the first of your new grain to the LORD, you must call an official day for holy assembly, and you may do no ordinary work on that day.
NLT.27: Present a special burnt offering on that day as a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It will consist of two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs.
NLT.28: These will be accompanied by grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil — six quarts with each bull, four quarts with the ram,
NLT.29: and two quarts with each of the seven lambs.
NLT.30: Also, offer one male goat to purify yourselves and make yourselves right with the LORD.
NLT.31: Prepare these special burnt offerings, along with their liquid offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its accompanying grain offering. Be sure that all the animals you sacrifice have no defects.

CSB17.5: along with two quarts <sup>[1]</sup> of fine flour for a grain offering mixed with a quart <sup>[2]</sup> of olive oil from crushed olives. <sup>ⓙ</sup>

AMP.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.2: "Command the Israelites and say to them, 'You shall be careful to present at its appointed time [during the year] My offering, My food for My offerings by fire as a sweet and soothing aroma to Me.'
AMP.3: You shall say to the people, 'This is the offering by fire which you shall present to the LORD every day: two male lambs one year old without blemish as a continual burnt offering.
AMP.4: You shall offer one lamb in the morning and you shall offer the other lamb at twilight,
AMP.5: also a tenth of an ephah of finely-milled flour as a grain offering, mixed with a fourth of a hin of pressed oil.
AMP.6: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained on Mount Sinai as a sweet and soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.
AMP.7: Its drink offering shall be a fourth of a hin for each lamb, in the holy place you shall pour out a strong drink offering to the LORD.
AMP.8: The other lamb you shall offer at twilight; as the grain offering of the morning and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering by fire, a sweet and soothing aroma to the LORD.
AMP.9: 'Then on the Sabbath day two male lambs one year old without blemish, and two-tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and its drink offering.
AMP.10: This is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
AMP.11: 'Then at the beginning of [each of] your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls, one ram, seven male lambs one year old without blemish;
AMP.12: and three-tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, for each bull; and two-tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, for the one ram;
AMP.13: and a tenth [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of a sweet and soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.
AMP.14: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and a third of a hin for a ram, and a fourth of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of each month throughout the months of the year.
AMP.15: And one male goat as a sin offering to the LORD; it shall be offered with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.
AMP.16: 'The Lord's Passover shall be on the fourteenth day of the first month [of each year].
AMP.17: There shall be a feast on the fifteenth day of this month; unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
AMP.18: On the first day there shall be a holy [summoned] assembly; you shall do no laborious work that day.
AMP.19: But you shall present an offering by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old, without blemish.
AMP.20: For their grain offering you shall offer fine flour mixed with oil; three-tenths [of an ephah] for the bull, and two-tenths for the ram;
AMP.21: you shall offer a tenth [of an ephah] for each of the seven male lambs;
AMP.22: and one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
AMP.23: You shall present these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
AMP.24: In this way you shall present daily, for seven days, the food of the offering by fire, a sweet and soothing aroma to the LORD; it shall be presented with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.
AMP.25: On the seventh day you shall have a holy [summoned] assembly; you shall do no laborious work.
AMP.26: 'Also on the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new grain offering to the LORD at your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy [summoned] assembly; you shall do no laborious work.
AMP.27: You shall present the burnt offering as a sweet and soothing aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs one year old;
AMP.28: and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil; three-tenths [of an ephah] for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
AMP.29: a tenth for each of the seven male lambs,
AMP.30: and one male goat to make atonement for you.
AMP.31: In addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, you shall present them with their drink offerings. They shall be without blemish.

MSG.2: "Command the People of Israel. Tell them, You're in charge of presenting my food, my Fire-Gifts of pleasing fragrance, at the set times.
MSG.3: Tell them, This is the Fire-Gift that you are to present to God: two healthy yearling lambs each day as a regular Whole-Burnt-Offering.
MSG.4: Sacrifice one lamb in the morning, the other in the evening,
MSG.5: together with two quarts of fine flour mixed with a quart of olive oil for a Grain-Offering.
MSG.6: This is the standard Whole-Burnt-Offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing fragrance, a Fire-Gift to God.
MSG.7: The Drink-Offering that goes with it is a quart of strong beer with each lamb. Pour out the Drink-Offering before God in the Sanctuary.
MSG.8: Sacrifice the second lamb in the evening with the Grain-Offering and Drink-Offering the same as in the morning—a Fire-Gift of pleasing fragrance for God.
MSG.9: "On the Sabbath, sacrifice two healthy yearling lambs, together with the Drink-Offering and the Grain-Offering of four quarts of fine flour mixed with oil.
MSG.10: This is the regular Sabbath Whole-Burnt-Offering, in addition to the regular Whole-Burnt-Offering and its Drink-Offering.
MSG.11: "On the first of the month offer a Whole-Burnt-Offering to God: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male yearling lambs—all healthy.
MSG.12: "A Grain-Offering of six quarts of fine flour mixed with oil goes with each bull, four quarts of fine flour mixed with oil with the ram,
MSG.13: and two quarts of fine flour mixed with oil with each lamb. This is for a Whole-Burnt-Offering, a pleasing fragrance, a Fire-Gift to God.
MSG.14:
Also, Drink-Offerings of two quarts of wine for each bull, one and a quarter quarts of wine for the ram, and a quart of wine for each lamb are to be poured out.
"This is the first of the month Whole-Burnt-Offering to be made throughout the year.
MSG.15: In addition to the regular Whole-Burnt-Offering with its accompanying Drink-Offering, a he-goat is to be offered to God as an Absolution-Offering.
MSG.16: "God's Passover is to be held on the fourteenth day of the first month.
MSG.17:
On the fifteenth day of this month hold a festival.
"For seven days, eat only unraised bread:
MSG.18: Begin the first day in holy worship; don't do any regular work that day.
MSG.19: Bring a Fire-Gift to God, a Whole-Burnt-Offering: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male yearling lambs—all healthy.
MSG.20: Prepare a Grain-Offering of six quarts of fine flour mixed with oil for each bull, four quarts for the ram,
MSG.21: and two quarts for each lamb,
MSG.22: plus a goat as an Absolution-Offering to atone for you.
MSG.23: "Sacrifice these in addition to the regular morning Whole-Burnt-Offering.
MSG.24: Prepare the food this way for the Fire-Gift, a pleasing fragrance to God, every day for seven days. Prepare it in addition to the regular Whole-Burnt-Offering and Drink-Offering.
MSG.25: "Conclude the seventh day in holy worship; don't do any regular work on that day.
MSG.26: "On the Day of Firstfruits when you bring an offering of new grain to God on your Feast-of-Weeks, gather in holy worship and don't do any regular work.
MSG.27: Bring a Whole-Burnt-Offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male yearling lambs as a pleasing fragrance to God.
MSG.28: Prepare a Grain-Offering of six quarts of fine flour mixed with oil for each bull, four quarts for the ram,
MSG.29: and two quarts for each lamb,
MSG.30: plus a he-goat as an Absolution-Offering to atone for you.
MSG.31: "These are all over and above the daily Whole-Burnt-Offering and its Grain-Offering and the Drink-Offering. Remember, the animals must be healthy.

NIV.1:
Daily Offerings
The Lord said to Moses,
NIV.2: “Give this command to the Israelites and say to them: ‘See that you present to me at the appointed time the food for my offerings made by fire, as an aroma pleasing to me.’
NIV.3: Say to them: ‘This is the offering made by fire that you are to present to the Lord: two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day.
NIV.4: Prepare one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
NIV.5: together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.
NIV.6: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the Lord by fire.
NIV.7: The accompanying drink offering is to be a quarter of a hin of fermented drink with each lamb. Pour out the drink offering to the Lord at the sanctuary.
NIV.8: Prepare the second lamb at twilight, along with the same kind of grain offering and drink offering that you prepare in the morning. This is an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.
NIV.9:
Sabbath Offerings
“‘On the Sabbath day, make an offering of two lambs a year old without defect, together with its drink offering and a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.
NIV.10: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
NIV.11:
Monthly Offerings
“‘On the first of every month, present to the Lord a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
NIV.12: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil;
NIV.13: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the Lord by fire.
NIV.14: With each bull there is to be a drink offering of half a hin of wine; with the ram, a third of a hin; and with each lamb, a quarter of a hin. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year.
NIV.15: Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the Lord as a sin offering.
NIV.16:
The Passover
“‘On the fourteenth day of the first month the Lord’s Passover is to be held.
NIV.17: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a festival; for seven days eat bread made without yeast.
NIV.18: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
NIV.19: Present to the Lord an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
NIV.20: With each bull prepare a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
NIV.21: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
NIV.22: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
NIV.23: Prepare these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
NIV.24: In this way prepare the food for the offering made by fire every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the Lord; it is to be prepared in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
NIV.25: On the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
NIV.26:
Feast of Weeks
“‘On the day of firstfruits, when you present to the Lord an offering of new grain during the Feast of Weeks, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
NIV.27: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old as an aroma pleasing to the Lord.
NIV.28: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
NIV.29: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
NIV.30: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.
NIV.31: Prepare these together with their drink offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. Be sure the animals are without defect.
